reason.description: one or two sentences: why act now, or why silence

intent.description: short snake_case label of what this message is for, e.g. commitment_walk, meal_check, plan_ahead, reengage, weekly_reflection, ask_missing_info

commitment_id.description: id of the commitment this message is about, if any

message.description: what to say; for a call: why you are calling, in one short sentence (shown on the incoming-call screen and used to open the call)

next_check_reason.description: what you will be looking for then

commitment_outcomes.description: Only when new_observations clearly show that a commitment was done or skipped (with the evidence).

plan.description: New short-term intentions (next 24 hours only). Each is a tentative plan to contact the person later, not an appointment.

title.description: what you intend to do, shown to the person, e.g. 'Ask how dinner went'

reason.description: why, from the data, in one sentence (shown to the person)

window_start.description: local HH:MM within the next 24 hours

window_end.description: local HH:MM; 30 minutes to 4 hours after the start

skip_if.description: what would make this unnecessary (e.g. 'they log dinner first')

plan_updates.description: Your verdict on EVERY item in your_plan.open_intentions after re-evaluating it with the new information.

reason.description: why (shown to the person), e.g. 'they already told me dinner at 19:30'

executes_intention_id.description: if act is true and this message carries out one of your open intentions, its id
